definitions.explanation: The current price at which a share of stock is traded on the stock market.

examples.japanese: {株価|かぶか}が{急落|きゅうらく}した。
{今日|きょう}の{株価|かぶか}を{確認|かくにん}する。
{株価|かぶか}が{上昇|じょうしょう}して{利益|りえき}が{出|で}た。
examples.english: I made a profit because the stock price rose.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {株価|かぶか}が{上|あ}がる (stock price rises)
- {株価|かぶか}が{下|さ}がる (stock price falls)
- {株価|かぶか}{指数|しすう} (stock price index)
- {株価|かぶか}{変動|へんどう} (stock price fluctuation)

RELATED TERMS:
- {株式|かぶしき} (stocks, shares)
- {株|かぶ} (stock, share)
- {株主|かぶぬし} (shareholder)
- {相場|そうば} (market price)
